examples.text: The politician was criticized for his ambiguous statements and lack of precision.

glosses: Hesitant; uncertain; not taking sides.

examples.text: And forasmuch as in this same question I am ambiguous, and Simplicius is resolute....

glosses: Having two or more equally applicable meanings; capable of double or multiple interpretation.

examples.text: For the beauties of Shakespeare are not of so dim or equivocal a nature as to be visible only to learned eyes.

examples.text: Some equivocals are merely ambiguous. Sharp is an example. It is equivocal since it is appropriate to call different types of things 'sharp' though what it is for them to be sharp differs.
